sentences.en: He wants to equip his son with a good education.
sentences.zh: 他想给儿子提供良好的教育。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to equip thousands of houses with solar power.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要为成千上万的房子配备太阳能供电系统。

sentences.en: Yanni needs to equip himself to be alone.
sentences.zh: 杨尼需要做好独自生活的准备。

senses.zh: 装备，配备；使具备（能力、知识等），使有准备
